why: No major reviewer covers this. The two Frigate docs pages are official, but they cover detectors and installation in general and name no NAS. The rest are guides that point to SBCs, mini PCs or Proxmox, plus a vendor page and a NAS surveillance guide with no models. None names a NAS model to buy, so a focused page comparing NAS models with prices and accelerator support would have little competition.
